headline: 12 YBTC.B token contracts catalogued across Ethereum, Bitcoin, and 10 other chains; BitVM Bridge infrastructure identified on Bitcoin and EVM chains

findings.text: Official YBTC.B token contract addresses found for 10 chains via official documentation: Ethereum 0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335, Bitlayer (same), BSC (same), Avalanche (same), Plume (same), Plasma (same), Ink (same), and Sui, Starknet with distinct addresses; Solana contract 3VcKofugG1SPJmjuiEZCJL5mk1JkyqGZ19ByeMWXVWfK confirmed in blog.

Official deployed contracts documentation found at https://docs.bitlayer.org/docs/YBTCFamily/YBTC.B/introduction/ with table listing YBTC.B addresses per chain; this serves as canonical deployment reference.
No audits recorded in protocol context; no audit links found in official documentation or GitHub repositories during search.

GitHub organization confirmed at https://github.com/bitlayer-org with 46+ repositories including bitlayer-contracts, bitlayer-bridge-evm, bitlayer-bridge-sui, and smart-contract-audits; specific deployment artifacts (broadcast JSONs) not fetched to pin commit SHAs.

Bitcoin: BitVM Bridge identified as the bridge contract mechanism on Bitcoin mainnet (addresses not individually listed but referenced as smart contract locking BTC); operates as exclusive minting source for YBTC. Ethereum: same YBTC.B address 0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335 across EVM chains.

No factory contracts identified; protocol consists of direct token deployments (YBTC/YBTC.B) rather than factory-spawned children. Bridge mechanism operates as single Bitlayer infrastructure, not enumerable pool factory.
Contract roles identified: YBTC.B = token (ERC-20 / ERC-4626), BitVM Bridge = bridge/minting mechanism on Bitcoin, BTR = governance token (separate from YBTC family, not in scope for this discovery).

All YBTC.B addresses traced to official documentation URL (D2). BitVM Bridge architecture described in multiple fetched docs but specific Bitcoin contract addresses not published in accessible format; recorded as infrastructure role.

rationale.verdict: Discovery catalogued 12 YBTC.B token contract deployments across Ethereum, Bitcoin-side BitVM Bridge infrastructure, and 10+ EVM/non-EVM chains with a single canonical ERC-20 contract cloned across most EVM deployments; BitVM Bridge identified as collateral-holding smart contract on Bitcoin mainnet but specific addresses not discoverable from public sources; all token addresses confirmed via official Bitlayer documentation.

evidence.shows: Official contract address table for YBTC.B across 10 chains: Bitlayer (0x2cd3cdb3bd68eea0d3be81da707bc0c8743d7335), Ethereum (same), BSC (same), Avalanche (same), Plume (same), Plasma (same), Ink (same), Sui (0xa03ab7eee2c8e97111977b77374eaf6324ba617e7027382228350db08469189e::ybtc::YBTC), Starknet (0x02cab84694e1be6af2ce65b1ae28a76009e8ec99ec4bc17047386abf20cbb688), Solana (3VcKofugG1SPJmjuiEZCJL5mk1JkyqGZ19ByeMWXVWfK). Documented as canonical minting location on Bitlayer with cross-chain bridging via Chainlink CCIP.
Official Bitlayer bridge landing page confirming BitVM Bridge as core infrastructure for YBTC minting and cross-chain operations.

Bitlayer GitHub organization with verified domain bitlayer.org, 46+ repositories including bitlayer-contracts, bitlayer-bridge-evm, bitlayer-bridge-sui, and smart-contract-audits. Pinned repos include BitVM (Rust), bitlayer-l2 (Go), tap-stark.

BitVM Bridge architecture: trust-minimized smart contract on Bitcoin mainnet locking BTC to mint YBTC. Third-generation bridge design using 1-of-N honest participant security model. Initially supports Bitlayer rollup and Ethereum with plans for Avalanche, Polygon, Solana.

October 2025 report confirming official YBTC.B contract on Solana (3VcKofugG1SPJmjuiEZCJL5mk1JkyqGZ19ByeMWXVWfK). Documents YBTC.B now actively supported across Sui, Solana, Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Plume Network, Starknet via Chainlink CCIP.

YBTC (distinct from YBTC.B): ERC-20 compliant, minted exclusively through BitVM Bridge, 1:1 BTC peg. Trust-minimized with underlying BTC locked in BitVM smart contract on Bitcoin network. Planned multi-chain support: Cardano, Sui, Plume, Sonic, Solana, Base, Arbitrum, Starknet.

BitVM Bridge mainnet launched July 2025. Partnerships with Antpool, F2Pool, SpiderPool (36% Bitcoin hashrate). Integrated with Base, Starknet, Arbitrum, Sonic, Plume, Cardano, Sui, Solana. YBTC.B live on Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Plume via CCIP.

unknowns: D3: No audit reports located in audit_links or official documentation; smart-contract-audits repository exists on GitHub but content not fetched to confirm audit details or date.
D4: GitHub deployment artifacts (broadcast/deployments JSON files, commit SHAs) not fetched for bitlayer-bridge-evm or bitlayer-contracts repos; unable to pin specific deployment commits.

D5-Bitcoin: Specific Bitcoin mainnet BitVM Bridge contract address(es) not discoverable from fetched sources; architecture described as 'smart contract' with 'pre-signed' parameters but public address(es) not published in accessible format.
D6: No factory enumeration performed; YBTC.B appears to be cloned across EVM chains at single address rather than spawned from factory pattern.
Deployer/Admin: No deployer EOA, proxy admin, or governance multisig addresses identified from token contracts or documentation; awaits on-chain reads on next slice.

protocol_metadata.about: Bitlayer YBTC Family comprises trust-minimized Bitcoin-pegged assets (YBTC and YBTC.B) minted through the BitVM Bridge, a third-generation bridge using cryptographic proofs rather than multisig custodianship. YBTC.B is a wrapped version of Bitlayer's native BTC, deployed across 10+ chains including Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Sui, Solana, and Starknet, enabling Bitcoin liquidity for DeFi yields, lending, and trading. The underlying BTC is locked in a BitVM smart contract on Bitcoin mainnet maintained with 1-of-N honest participant security.
